name: Rejection Reason 89 Code
definition: Specifies the reason why the instruction request has a rejected status.

ADEA.name: Account Servicer Deadline Missed
ADEA.definition: Transaction/instruction received after the account servicer's specified deadline.

CERT.name: Incorrect Certification
CERT.definition: Instruction is rejected since the provided certification is incorrect or incomplete.

INVA.name: Invalid For Tax Authorities
INVA.definition: For tax reclaim, the reclaim is invalid for the tax authorities.

LACK.name: Lackof Securities
LACK.definition: Instructed position exceeds the eligible balance.

NMTY.name: Mismatch
NMTY.definition: Mismatch between option number and option type.

FULL.name: Missing Beneficiary Owner Details
FULL.definition: Rejected due to missing beneficiary owner details.

CANC.name: Option Cancelled
CANC.definition: Option is not valid; it has been cancelled by the market or service provider, and cannot be responded to. Any responses already processed against this option are considered void and new responses will be required.

INTV.name: Option Inactive
INTV.definition: Option is not active and can no longer be responded to. Any responses already processed against this option will remain valid, for example, expired option.

REFT.name: Refused By Tax Authorities
REFT.definition: Reclaim is refused by the tax authorities.

SAFE.name: Safekeeping Account Rejection
SAFE.definition: Unrecognised or invalid message sender's safekeeping account.

DQCS.name: Amount Rejection
DQCS.definition: Unrecognised or invalid instructed cash amount.

DQAM.name: Instruction Type Rejection
DQAM.definition: Invalid use of instructed amount (QCAS) or of instructed quantity (QINS) qualifiers.

IRDQ.name: Invalid Use Round Up Quantity
IRDQ.definition: Instruction is rejected due to invalid use of the additional round up quantity.

DQBV.name: Invalid Bid Value
DQBV.definition: Bid price / basis points / percentage falls outside of bid range for the event (generally used in Dutch Auctions or Bid Tenders).

DQBI.name: Invalid Bid Increment
DQBI.definition: Bid price / basis points / percentage increments rejected due to invalid bid increment for the event (generally used in Dutch Auctions or Bid Tenders).

SHAR.name: Shareholder Number Rejection
SHAR.definition: Unrecognised, missing or invalid shareholder number.

ITAX.name: Incorrect Tax Rate
ITAX.definition: Tax rate provided is incorrect. It falls outside the acceptable values for that investment country.

NTAX.name: Inconsistent Tax Rate
NTAX.definition: Tax rate is not consistent with the documentation in place.

ISOL.name: Invalid Solicitation Dealer Fee Use
ISOL.definition: Invalid use of solicitation dealer fee indicator.

BSTR.name: Before Instruction Period
BSTR.definition: Instruction is submitted before instruction start date.

DUPL.name: Duplicate Instruction
DUPL.definition: Instruction is rejected due to duplicate business message identifier.

PROI.name: Missing Protect Identification
PROI.definition: Protect identification is required for cover protect instructions.

PRON.name: No Protect Privilege
PRON.definition: No protect privilege for this event.

PROT.name: Missing Protect Date
PROT.definition: Protect date is required for cover protect instructions.

TRTI.name: Missing Transaction Type
TRTI.definition: Transaction type is missing or invalid for protect or cover protect instructions.

IPAW.name: Invalid Paperwork
IPAW.definition: Required paperwork is invalid, incomplete or missing.

REJA.name: Rejected By Issuer Agent
REJA.definition: Instruction rejected by the issuer agent.

IPED.name: Instruction Prior To Entitlement Date
IPED.definition: Instruction was received prior to entitlement date.

BUMM.name: Buyer Protection Mismatch
BUMM.definition: Counterparty disagreement on the chosen corporate action outturn.

DSNA.name: No Buyer Protection Allowed
DSNA.definition: Underlying transaction type/status does not allow for a buyer protection.

DUCK.name: Underlying Transaction Cancelled
DUCK.definition: Buyer Protection instruction rejected since underlying settlement transaction has been cancelled.

DUST.name: Underlying Transaction Already Settled
DUST.definition: Buyer Protection instruction was rejected, because the underlying settlement transaction has already been settled.

ECMD.name: Election To Counterparty Market Deadline Missed
ECMD.definition: Received after the election to counterparty market deadline.

ECRD.name: Election To Counterparty Response Deadline Missed
ECRD.definition: Received after the election to counterparty response market deadline.

INSA.name: Instruction Not Supported Or Allowed
INSA.definition: Instruction is not supported or allowed.

DSEC.name: Invalid Security
DSEC.definition: Unrecognised or invalid financial instrument identification.
